notes: Cisco's own product/spec pages (cisco.com) returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch, so this was compiled from the Cisco Hardware Installation Guide content as mirrored on ManualsLib, cross-checked against multiple resellers (networkoutlet.com, networkdevicesinc.com, B&H listing found via search) and Cisco's data-sheet summary via search snippets. Key figures (24x RJ45 PoE+ downlinks, modular uplink bay, RJ45 console, USB mini-B console, USB-A storage port, RJ45 MGMT port, StackWise-480, 1RU, PWR-C1-715WAC default PSU) were consistent across all sources. Two items are approximations: (1) the uplink bay ships empty on this SKU — no fixed uplink connector/speed is guaranteed until a network module (1G/10G/25G/40G) is purchased and installed, so that port's connector/grade should be treated as indicative only; (2) the AC input receptacle is documented as IEC 320-C16 (a locking variant), which has no exact match in the allowed connector list — it was mapped to iec-c19 as the closest high-current IEC option rather than plain "iec" (C13/14). StackWise-480 stacking ports and the StackPower connector on the rear panel are proprietary Cisco connectors with no equivalent in the allowed connector list and were omitted rather than force-mapped. Confidence is medium because the manufacturer's own site blocked direct fetch and specifics were triangulated from a mirrored installation guide plus reseller pages rather than a single authoritative page load.

ports.name: GigabitEthernet 1/0/1-24 (PoE+)
ports.note: 24x downlink ports, 10/100/1000 Mbps copper, 802.3at PoE+ up to 30W/port (445W PoE budget with default PSU, up to 720W with upgraded PSU)

ports.name: Uplink Module Slot
ports.note: Empty modular uplink bay on base SKU; populated by an optional network module (e.g. C9300-NM-4G for 1G RJ45/SFP, C9300-NM-8X for 10G SFP+, C9300-NM-2Q for 40G QSFP+, C9300-NM-2Y for 25G SFP28). No fixed uplink ports ship with this part number, so exact connector/grade depends on the module installed and cannot be confirmed as shipped.

ports.name: MGMT
ports.note: Dedicated 10/100/1000 Ethernet out-of-band management port (VRF interface)

ports.name: CONSOLE (RJ-45)
ports.note: Rear-panel RJ-45 serial console port, 9600 baud; ships with RJ-45-to-DB-9 adapter

ports.name: CONSOLE (USB)
ports.note: Front-panel USB 5-pin mini-Type-B console port; closest listed connector id used since usb-mini-b is not in the allowed set

ports.name: USB Type-A
ports.note: Front-panel USB storage port for Cisco USB flash drives (128MB-8GB)

ports.name: AC Power Supply Input
ports.note: Default PWR-C1-715WAC power supply (optional 350W or 1100W variants also supported); AC input receptacle is IEC 320-C16, which is not a distinct id in the allowed list — mapped to the closest high-current locking IEC option (iec-c19). Two internal hot-swappable PSU bays.
